WAFF AMPUTEE FOOTBALL WORLD CUP 2026 MEXICO English Español WAFF AMPUTEE FOOTBALL WORLD CUP 2026 MEXICO Close From its early international competitions in the 1980s, amputee football has grown into a truly global sport, bringing together players, teams and communities from around the world. What began with pioneering tournaments in the United States has developed over more than four decades into an established international movement built on competition, inclusion, resilience and a shared passion for football. The Amputee Football World Cup has played a central role in this journey. Over the years, teams from Africa, Asia, Europe and the Americas have come together to compete at the highest level and to showcase the quality, intensity and spirit of amputee football. Recent World Cups have taken place in Culiacán, Mexico in 2014, San Juan de los Lagos, Mexico in 2018, and Istanbul, Türkiye in 2022. At the most recent World Cup, Türkiye was crowned World Champion in 2022, winning the title on home soil.
